active.packageId: Checklist #14 follow-up stage 2: trusted PBC final completion and durable provider handoff
active.worktree: Commit df73109 adds the trusted final-completion boundary after staged PBC chunks: staff-gated completion re-reads every staged chunk, verifies receipt digests and the combined SHA-256, rejects executable magic-number content, marks the intent STAGED, and enqueues a durable TransferPbcDocument.v1 operation in the same transaction. A SIMULATED worker handoff registers provider receipt evidence and only then marks the intent and PBC request RECEIVED; interrupted effects preserve RESULT_UNCERTAIN and reconcile, deterministic rejection lands PROVIDER_BLOCKED, and safe transient failures retry. Local verification passed on head df73109; hosted CI has not run on this head yet.
